errors.description: The agent misinterpreted a key grammatical rule from the prompt. The prompt stated, '...the thing doing the liking is actually the object of the sentence rather than the subject.' This means 'I' (the liker) should be the object (using the accusative form 'Mato'), and 'apples' (the thing being liked) should be the subject (using the nominative form 'Apple'). The agent incorrectly applied the English grammatical structure (I=subject, apples=object) to the Tizin sentence, leading to an incorrect translation.
